name: token_optimizer
description:
Compresses code or text to reduce token count before sending to a remote LLM — removes comments, docstrings, blank lines, and optionally produces a concise structural summary.
Use when: a file or snippet is too large for a prompt, you need to trim context before an LLM call, or you want to estimate compression savings.
Scope: local text processing only. No network access. Works on any language.
Not for: permanent file modification (source is unchanged), context window management of files-in-session (use context_pruner), or reading files from disk (combine with get_file).

text.description: The code or text to compress.

mode.description: 'compress': remove comments, docstrings, blank lines, leading whitespace (preserves structure). 'summarize': return a compact structural outline (functions, classes, key logic). 'both': compress first, then append summary.

language.description: Language hint for comment stripping: 'python', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'go', 'rust', 'java', 'c', 'cpp', 'shell', 'auto'. Default: 'auto' (detected from content).

preserve_structure.description: If true, keep one blank line between top-level definitions (classes, functions) for readability. Default: true.
